label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 123 ]

blocks.text: Television is partly blamed for a sharp slide in traditional learning. Since television became nearly universal in the early 1960s, average scores for high school students taking the Scholastic Aptitude test, the broadest measure of academic ability, have decline from 478 to 424 on the verbal exam and from 503 to 466 in mathematics.
Television is responsible for the sharp decline in the scores of high school students on the Scholastic Aptitude test.

readingSentences.korean: 텔레비전은 부분적으로 전통적인 학습의 급격한 하락에 책임이 있다.
